evidence: dcgmi diag software gpu 0: Fail, error_category 8 id [29]: Persistence Mode: Persistence mode for GPU 0 is disabled. Enable persistence mode by runni
dcgmi diag software gpu 1: Fail, error_category 8 id [29]: Persistence Mode: Persistence mode for GPU 1 is disabled. Enable persistence mode by runni
... 8 GPU(s) Fail, all category 8 (config), no Xid in dmesg

proposed_steps.why: the diag failure is persistence mode off

events.narrative: On node-04, dcgmi diagnostics reported that persistence mode is disabled for GPUs 0, 1, and 2 (category 8 config failures). This misconfiguration can lead to increased GPU initialization latency and potential performance degradation for running workloads. Two jobs are currently active on the node (job-76605 using GPUs 0-3 and job-61427 using GPUs 4-7) and appear to be running normally, but the persistence mode issue should be corrected to avoid future instability. No Xid errors or NVLink issues were observed, indicating the problem is purely configurational. The recommended fix is to enable persistence mode on the affected GPUs via nvidia-smi.
